title: 252/7 Season Opener Explosion vs NJ Revenants
caption: Garden State Strikers pile up 252/7 in 20 overs at Cedar Brook Park and restrict NJ Revenants to 107/9 for a 145-run opening statement.

title: 207/5 Power Batting Display vs Team 1983 A
caption: Prabakaran Jayabalan and Gurjeet Sandhu lead the charge as GSS posts 207/5 and defends it by 36 runs to go 4-0 in Group B.

title: Clinical 7-Wicket Chase vs Jersey Indians at Robbinsville
caption: Chasing 151 in the afternoon session at Robbinsville, the Strikers race to 155/3 in just 16.4 overs with 7 wickets in hand.

title: Bowling Out Sonett US CC for 88 at Johnson 3
caption: Santosh Lalan, Amit Kumar, and Mandeep Singh dismantle Sonett US Cricket Club for 88 before wrapping up a 5-wicket win in 12.1 overs.

title: Qualifier 1 Masterclass: Mumbai Gymkhana All Out for 60
caption: Under playoff pressure at Howe Ground, GSS defends 131/8 by skittling #1 seed Mumbai Gymkhana for 60 in 15.4 overs to win by 71 runs.

title: Gold Division Championship Finalists (10W-2L-1NR Season)
caption: Garden State Strikers celebrate a dominant 2026 Summer T20 Saturday Gold Division campaign finishing as Runner-Up with a +1.7142 NRR.
